title: Distributional Treatment Effect Transportability across Heterogeneous Sites
abstract: arXiv:2511.09759v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study distributional transportability of treatment effects in a ``cross-site, one-armed target" design, where both treated and control units are observed in a source site, but only control units are observed in a target site. Our object of interest is not estimating the average treatment effect, but recovering the full treated distribution in the target site using transfer knowledge from the source site, while allowing cross-site heterogeneity in measurement systems, observed features, outcome reporting, population composition, and latent contextual factors. We model cross-site heterogeneity through a transformation between the sites that transports the joint feature--outcome distributions. This transformation is learned from comparing the observed control samples in the source and target sites, using an optimal transport criterion. translated_title: 跨异构站点的分布型处理效应可迁移性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在“跨站点、单臂目标”设计下处理效应的分布可迁移性问题，其中源站点同时观测到处理组和对照组单元，而目标站点仅观测到对照组单元。我们关注的目标并非估计平均处理效应，而是利用源站点的迁移知识恢复目标站点完整的处理组分布，同时允许跨站点在测量系统、观测特征、结果报告、人群构成以及潜在情境因素等方面的异质性。我们通过在站点之间建立一个转换来建模跨站点异质性，该转换用于传输特征—结果的联合分布。这一转换通过最优传输准则，基于对源站点和目标站点所观测到的对照样本的比较而学习得到。随后，将学习到的转换应用于源站点的处理组样本，以构建一个合成的目标站点处理组分布。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于最优传输的方法，通过比较源站点与目标站点的对照样本学习站点间的分布转换，在允许跨站点异质性的前提下，恢复目标站点完整的处理组结果分布。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an optimal transport-based method that learns a cross-site distributional transformation from observed control samples to recover the full treated outcome distribution at the target site, while accommodating heterogeneity across sites.
